stylesheetRules: @layer c124-base { .c124-layered { position:absolute; left:20px; top:20px; width:110px; height:60px; z-index:1; } .c124-important { position:absolute; left:20px; top:20px; width:110px; height:60px; z-index:3 !important; } .c124-author-important { position:absolute; left:20px; top:20px; width:110px; height:60px; z-index:6 !important; } }
.c124-inline-normal { position:absolute; left:20px; top:20px; width:110px; height:60px; z-index:4; }
.c124-author-important-normal { position:absolute; left:20px; top:20px; width:110px; height:60px; z-index:7 !important; }
.c124-var { position:absolute; left:20px; top:20px; width:110px; height:60px; z-index:var(--c124-stack); }
.c124-registered { position:absolute; left:20px; top:20px; width:110px; height:60px; z-index:var(--c124-registered-z); }
.c124-pseudo::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:110px; height:60px; background-color:#2866f6; z-index:1; }
